name: loanboard
description: Section A of the Streamhub QA automation assessment: a loan dashboard and the Playwright + Cucumber suite around it.

scripts.test: node scripts/ensure-dirs.js && CUCUMBER_PUBLISH_QUIET=true start-server-and-test vite http://127.0.0.1:5173 test:cucumber
scripts.test:self-healing: node scripts/ensure-dirs.js && CUCUMBER_PUBLISH_QUIET=true start-server-and-test vite http://127.0.0.1:5173 "cucumber-js --profile selfHealing"
scripts.heal:poc: node scripts/ensure-dirs.js && start-server-and-test vite http://127.0.0.1:5173 "ts-node --transpile-only tests/self-heal/poc.ts"
